dedupe_keys.name: usda production supply and distribution psd online official usda estimates of production consumption trade and stocks of agricultural commodities by country

description: PSD Online is the public database behind the US Department of Agriculture's official supply and demand estimates for agricultural commodities around the world. For each country and commodity, such as wheat, maize, rice, soybeans, sugar, dairy and meat, it gives the balance for each marketing year: production, imports, exports, domestic consumption and ending stocks, with USDA's current-year projections revised each month in step with its World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates. The application lets users build tables by commodity and country, and the whole database is free to download as a zipped CSV, about 10 MB when checked. Caveats: the application renders by script and the FAS description page was blocked from this environment, so the attribute list here is the standard PSD balance, not read from a codebook; the figures are USDA estimates that can differ from national statistics and FAOSTAT; and no licence is stated on the page, though US federal data are generally public domain. Coverage is global. Simulation uses: commodity balances and stocks for food supply shock, trade restriction and drought impact models. Related records: the traceable food balance sheets (data-traceable-food-balance-sheets-gcamfaostat) give a FAOSTAT-based alternative for comparison.
